def parse_docstring(thing):
    """Parse a Python docstring, or the docstring found on `thing`.

    :return: a ``(title, body)`` tuple. As per docstring convention, title is
        the docstring's first paragraph and body is the rest.
    """
    docstring = getattr(thing, "__doc__", None)
    if docstring is None:
        return "", ""
    docstring = docstring.strip()
    title, body = docstring.partition("\n\n")
    title = title.strip()
    body = body.strip()
    return title, body

def parse_docstring_into_title_and_list(docstring):
    """Parse a Python docstring.

    :return: a ``(title, list)`` tuple. As per docstring convention, title is
        the docstring's first paragraph and list is the rest.
    """
    if docstring is None:
        return "", []
    docstring = docstring.strip()
    title, body = docstring.partition("\n\n")
    title = title.strip()
    body = body.strip()
    lines = body.split("\n")
    return title, lines


def parse_docstring_into_title_and_list_of_lists(docstring):
    """Parse a Python docstring.

    :return: a ``(title, list)`` tuple. As per docstring convention, title is
        the docstring's first paragraph and list is the rest.
    """
    if docstring is None:
        return "", []
    docstring = docstring.strip()
    title, body = docstring.partition("\n\n")
    title = title.strip()
    body = body.strip()
    lines = body.split("\n")
    lines = [line.strip() for line in lines]
    return title, lines
